This implies the vase was originally on a higher surface (like the dresser or desk) and fell down onto the guitar case. But the crime scene shows the vase remains are on the floor next to the guitar case, not on top of it. If the vase had fallen onto the guitar case, we would expect to see vase fragments and water on the guitar case itself, not just on the floor next to it.
